sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It requires the construction date on the ship, enforces exactly the 2017 edition within the inclusive/exclusive applicability interval with no contradictory additional edition, and rejects assertion of the 2017 edition outside that interval. No vocabulary matcher is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The conditional check is presence-only: it passes when the ship has an applicableIceClassRegulationEdition value of iceClassRegulationEdition2017 even if it also has a contradictory additional edition. Strengthen the applicable-date branch to require that the edition is 2017 and that no other value of applicableIceClassRegulationEdition exists; do not impose that value globally outside the stated date interval.

Preserve the prior repair instruction: the current sh:or logic still permits an in-range ship to pass through TRF002NotApplicableShape, whose SPARQL query selects the applicable date interval and therefore reports no violation only for the very cases that require the 2017 edition. Make the applicable-date constraint violation-oriented: select the ship when its contract date is in the interval and either no applicableIceClassRegulationEdition value is iceClassRegulationEdition2017 or any additional edition value exists. Make the other branch violation-oriented for dates outside the interval, using the complement of 2019-01-01 inclusive through 2021-07-05 exclusive. This must require exactly the 2017 edition, with no contradictory additional value, only within the stated interval; do not impose that edition globally. No vocabulary matcher is needed because all required canonical terms are supplied.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It requires the construction date on the ship, enforces exactly the 2017 edition within the inclusive/exclusive applicability interval with no contradictory additional edition, and rejects assertion of the 2017 edition outside that interval. No vocabulary matcher is required.
